datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across South Sudan administrative units. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases (IPC classifications) for 2014, aggregated into quarterly snapshots (January, April, July, October). Geographic boundaries and classification values were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
